contact.note: Pip's far mitten (outer edge) at a contact frame

idle.note: breathing loop; runtime picks a / blink / look at random each cycle

idle_blink.note: breathing loop; runtime picks a / blink / look at random each cycle

idle_look.note: breathing loop; runtime picks a / blink / look at random each cycle

wave.note: hello wave with the far mitten

think.note: hand on cheek, eyes up, a "..." bubble; play in -> loop -> out

point_right.note: points at something to Pip's right (mirror for left); a twinkle marks the spot each loop

focus.note: quiz focus: minimal motion, locked-in face

sleepy.note: dozing: slow breath, nodding, sprout wilts, Zzz

dragged.note: held by the pointer: dangling, feet kicking

drop.note: released after a drag: fall, squash, shake it off

reviewing.note: opens a book and reads: eyes track the lines, a page turns; play in -> loop -> out

pull_out_card.note: rummages in the backpack and holds up a flashcard; out puts it back

confused.note: head tilt, wilting sprout, a ? pops up

call_claude.note: calls out for the superbrain: mittens cupped round a wide-open shouting mouth like a megaphone, chin up to the upper right; the sprout nodes charge L-C-R, then on the all-lit beat a squash-stretch SHOUT sends ))) voice waves from the mouth and three concentric broadcast rings from the sprout; in -> loop -> out (out lowers the mittens, looks right, and a reply sparkle pings back from the right)

receive_claude_help.note: takes Clawd's answer card at the contact point, reads it, has an idea, nods, packs it away

clawd_bump.note: fist bump with Clawd to the right: wind up, punch to the contact point, burst, happy squash

idle_curious.note: curious idle: brows up, eyes dart left then up-right, little head tilts, perky sprout

blink.note: a single crisp blink from the neutral rest pose (plays between idles)

skeptical.note: side-eye: face turned away, eyes slid right, one lidded eye + one raised brow, fist on hip; loop = brow waggle

concerned.note: sympathetic worry: worried brows, frown, a sweat drop, mittens held together at the chest; loop = fidget

proud.note: breath in, chest out, fist on hip, smug eyes, chin up, a sparkle pops, a satisfied nod, settle

error_recover.note: after a wrong answer: flinch, shake it off, determined fist pump + stamp, warm smile

celebrate_big.note: big win: deep crouch, high jump with both arms up, confetti, double bounce, settle

hop.note: a quick little hop in place

land.note: arrives from above: falls in, big squash with dust, rebound, wobble, settle

sit.note: hops down to sit; seated breathing idle with wiggling feet; pushes back up to stand

stretch.note: big stretch: arms high, yawn, lean side to side, shake it out, settle

walk.note: walk cycle in place heading to the viewer's right (mirror for left): leans in, long reaching stride, far arm swings, dust kicks back, pack bounces; the planted foot slides 26 px per 8-frame step, so the site should move the sprite about 3.25 art px per frame

point_left.note: points with the near mitten at something to Pip's left; a twinkle marks the spot each loop

point_up.note: points straight up with the far mitten (at something above Pip); a twinkle marks the spot each loop

point_down.note: points down and out to the right (at something below Pip); a twinkle marks the spot each loop

explain.note: explains something: talking bubble, open-palm gestures on the beats, nods; play in -> loop -> out

peek.note: peeks over a UI edge (clip_y=108): sprout first, then eyes; looks around; ducks back down

hide.note: from standing: a nervous glance to the side ("!"), a shy blush, mittens over the eyes (peekaboo) in a trembling crouch, then ducks fast behind a UI edge (clip_y=108); the sprout goes last

rummage_backpack.note: takes the backpack off, opens it and hops right in; loop: sprout wiggling while things fly out, pops up with a card and flings it; out: pops out dazed, shrugs, shuts it and puts it back on

pull_out_source.note: finds a reference sheet in the pack, holds it up, reads it, nods ("idea"); loop holds it up. Loop pose = first frame of put_away_source

put_away_source.note: from the pull_out_source loop pose: slides the sheet back into the pack, pats it, rest

drag_ui_card.note: tug-of-war PULL: reaches out and grips a page card on its right (mittens fixed at frame (86,76)/(85.5,84)), then throws its weight BACK - tall, reclined far away from the card, chin up, mittens hauled in to the chest, feet braced out ahead of it; loop = heave back, feet skid toward the card (dust ahead), re-plant; out = the grip slips, it tumbles back onto its bottom, gets up, wipes its brow, grins

push_ui_card.note: PUSH like a heavy box: cocks its fists, then thrusts both palms flat onto a page card on its right (palms fixed at frame (87,73)/(86.5,83)) - low and wide, arms straight out, head down, body driving INTO the card, one foot far behind; loop = feet scramble, dust kicked out behind; out = the card gives, it lurches forward a step, rights itself, dusts off its mittens, satisfied smile
